newsitem.title: CHINA: China exporters to bid and pay for export rights.
newsitem.headline: China exporters to bid and pay for export rights.

text.p: Chinese exporters will have to bid and pay for the right to export 33 products beginning next year, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Prospective exporters would also have to bid, but not pay, to export black-and-white television sets, electric fans and bicycles from next year, it said, quoting officials from the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (MOFTEC).
The public bidding system was designed to ensure fairer and better distribution of export quotas, it said.
China had a system of quotas and licences for exports to regulate the foreign trade sector and allow exporters to raise their overseas sales prices, it said.
A total of 116 categories of exports were licensed in China, 95 of which were given quotas, it said.
MOFTEC, customs authorities and various chambers of commerce would monitor export prices to curb what recipient countries considered "dumping", it said.
MOFTEC would use the fees collected in the bidding process to promote Chinese exports, it said.
